evals.prompt: Repair the gaps in a stylized gate kit while preserving 0.5m grid, hinge pivot and unrelated artist collections.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Scopes data users and preserves source.
Returns measured and current visual evidence.
